text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Here is your Level 49 birthday 
present: a shoulder massage coupon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next, next! Let's go to the next 
level! Staring contest, ready, go~.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. If you wanna turn back, now's 
your chance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In Birthday-Limited Staring Contest Poker, 
the more you win, the higher-tier present 
you receive. However—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you lose, all your winnings so far get 
confiscated.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—And then, Betelgeuse goes supernova, and 
the entire Earth gets conquered by 
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Never heard of that lore. So, what're we 
gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, as if I'd ever hand over supremacy of 
the Earth to carrots.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Level 50! I'm gonna get my 
hands on that "Ticket to make her call me 
Golshi Big Sis"!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd make it this far... Our 
facial muscles are both at their absolute 
limit. This is the final showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's play staring contest. First one to 
laugh loses...!
